methodology:
Astarta Holding is a Cyprus-incorporated Ukrainian agricultural conglomerate listed on Warsaw Stock Exchange. Operates 220,000 hectares of agricultural land bank concentrated in central Ukraine (Poltava region), plus 6 sugar refineries, dairy farms, an oil extraction plant, 7 grain elevators, and a biogas facility. Reports in EUR; listed in PLN.

Ukrainian agricultural land is under significant wartime discount. Pre-war Ukrainian cropland traded at ~$2,000-3,000/acre USD; 2024 transactions for non-frontline cropland are in the $400-800/acre range, with central regions (Poltava, Vinnytsia) trading at the higher end. Astarta's land bank in the Poltava region is among the safer geographic concentrations.

FY25 (Dec 2025) revenue fell 23% to €472M as sugar volumes declined post war-disruption normalization. The land FMV reflects current wartime conditions; a peace-scenario revaluation back to pre-war prices would imply 3-5x higher per-acre values.
